# ANPR2MQTT

> Simple ANPR Camera Integration using File System and MQTT

ANPR2MQTT watches a camera's exported snapshot/event files (or an FTP or MQTT feed), runs OCR locally where needed, and publishes structured MQTT messages and images for Home Assistant auto-discovery.


## Usage

- [ANPR2MQTT](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/index.md): Project overview and quick start
- [ANPR Camera Configuration](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/camera/index.md): Configuring supported ANPR cameras
- [OCR](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/ocr/index.md): Configuring OCR field extraction
- [HomeAssistant Integration](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/homeassistant/index.md): Home Assistant MQTT integration
- [API](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/api/index.md): DVLA / VES lookup API integration
- [Debug Tools](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/debug_tools/index.md): CLI debug tools
